native_calls.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: monochrome source illustration (NOT a cell grid) for a Picross puzzle of approximately 13 columns by 25 rows. EDIT THE PROVIDED EXACT APPROVED SEAHORSE IMAGE into one clean simplified BLACK-AND-WHITE graphic. Preserve its identity, precise RIGHT-facing side profile, long downward-angled tubular snout, round visible eye, backward arched neck, convex belly on the right, small dorsal fin on the left, the entire tapering tail descending on the left then sweeping around the bottom into an open C-shaped inward curl on the right. Preserve the open central tail space and the gap between the curled tip and body; do not close it into a ring, do not reverse the pose. Same principal proportions, same overall tall/narrow aspect of the animal. This is a faithful abstraction of Image 1, not a new seahorse. Strong broad SOLID BLACK filled masses on plain OPAQUE WHITE background, crisp smooth curves, with just one clear simple WHITE eye opening inside the head. Consolidate the coronet and back armor points into a few broad bumps; simplify the dorsal fin to a filled fan-shaped lobe. Remove ALL armor plate lines, ribs, scales, speckling, color differences, gradients, hatching, shadows, glow and texture. The main body and tail should be solid black, not line art and not a hollow outline. Slightly reinforce narrow joins and tail thickness only as needed for later coarse monochrome sampling, keep the overall proportions and all major negative spaces. Keep the full animal visible with a small plain white margin. No text, numbers, boxes, cells, visible grid, border, added objects, background scene or decorative pixels. Black and white only, no gray shading. Deliver the single standalone abstracted illustration.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached black seahorse abstraction with ONE targeted change: make its eye a SINGLE SOLID WHITE OVAL HOLE inside the black head, removing the entire black pupil and tiny highlight currently inside the white eye. The white oval should be large and simple enough to survive later sampling around 25 cells tall. Preserve EVERYTHING ELSE exactly: the black outer silhouette, right-facing tubular snout, crown and back bumps, neck curve, rounded belly, left dorsal fin, tail shape, open C curl, body proportions, placement and plain opaque white background. No new marks, no texture, no lines, no shadow or text, no grid. The animal is solid black, with only the single white eye hole and the natural white exterior spaces. Do not generate a cell matrix.
